questions.prompt: What are the two main remote image servers in LXD?
questions.explanation: ubuntu: hosts official Ubuntu images. images: hosts community images for many Linux distributions.

questions.prompt: What happens when you launch an instance from a remote image for the first time?
options: LXD downloads and caches the image locally
LXD creates the instance on the remote server
LXD refuses — you must download manually
questions.answer: LXD downloads and caches the image locally
questions.explanation: LXD downloads the image from the remote and caches it. Subsequent launches use the cached copy.

questions.prompt: How do you list locally cached images?
questions.explanation: lxc image list (without a remote prefix) shows all locally cached images.

questions.prompt: How do you create a custom image from a stopped container?
questions.explanation: lxc publish <instance> --alias <name> creates a new image from the instance's filesystem.

questions.prompt: Can you delete a local image that's in use by a running instance?
options: No — stop or delete the instance first
Yes — the image is kept until the instance is deleted
questions.answer: No — stop or delete the instance first
questions.explanation: LXD prevents deletion of images in use by running instances.

questions.prompt: How do you create an image from a snapshot named 'clean' on instance 'web'?
questions.explanation: lxc publish web/clean --alias <name> creates an image from the snapshot without stopping the instance.
